quotes.quote: I’m seriously in the sh*ttiest mood right now. Piss off, or I’ll kill you.
You don’t have to bow your head. Just have a heart that cares for others.

I didn’t expect my life would end up like this. I live in a beat-up apartment with thin walls. My manager who’s younger than me treats me like an idiot. Even kids make fun of me, and I had to apologize to them. I’ve only ever got one girlfriend, and that was in middle school. Just where did I go wrong?
The moment I thought I was going to die, I remembered Tachibana Hinata.
I had totally forgotten!! I am just me.
When it comes to the desire to save tachibana, I won’t lose to Naoto.
